title: Factor-group symmetry analysis of Raman-active modes
action: Perform factor-group analysis for the hexagonal β-Ge3N4 (space group P6₃/m, Z=2) and cubic spinel γ-Ge3N4 (space group Fd̅3m, Z=2) to determine the irreducible representation labels and multiplicities of the zone-center Raman-active optical phonons.
description: The analysis predicts the number of Raman-active modes (11 for β, 5 for γ) and their symmetry types (β: A_g, E_{1g}, E_{2g}; γ: A_{1g}, E_g, T_{2g}), which are needed to assign the computed modes.

title: DFT structure optimization
action: Perform DFT-LDA plane-wave pseudopotential relaxation for β-Ge3N4 (hexagonal, lattice constants a=8.028 Å, c=3.052 Å) and γ-Ge3N4 (cubic, a=8.2125 Å), optimizing internal atomic coordinates until forces are sufficiently small.
description: Optimized structures are required for subsequent phonon calculations.

title: Zone-center phonon calculation
action: For each optimized structure, compute the Γ-point (zone-center) phonon frequencies and eigenvectors using a direct force-constant matrix method within DFT-LDA.
description: Yields raw phonon modes that will be processed into Raman-active mode tables.

title: Extract and assign Raman modes for β-Ge3N4
action: From the phonon eigenvectors and frequencies for β-Ge3N4, identify the 11 Raman-active modes belonging to the A_g, E_{1g}, and E_{2g} irreducible representations (as predicted by factor-group analysis), extract their frequencies in cm⁻¹, and write the results to beta_phonon_frequencies.csv.
description: CSV table of Raman-active zone-center modes for β-Ge3N4 with frequency and symmetry assignment. The number of rows must be exactly 11.
output_schema: A CSV file with columns: mode_id (integer from 1 to 11), computed_frequency (float, cm⁻¹), symmetry (string). The rows can be in any order, but all 11 modes must be present.

title: Extract and assign Raman modes for γ-Ge3N4
action: From the phonon eigenvectors and frequencies for γ-Ge3N4, identify the 5 Raman-active modes belonging to the A_{1g}, E_g, and T_{2g} irreducible representations, extract their frequencies in cm⁻¹, and write the results to gamma_phonon_frequencies.csv.
description: CSV table of Raman-active zone-center modes for γ-Ge3N4 with frequency and symmetry assignment. The number of rows must be exactly 5.
output_schema: A CSV file with columns: mode_id (integer from 1 to 5), computed_frequency (float, cm⁻¹), symmetry (string). The rows can be in any order, but all 5 modes must be present.
